__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource for Codex session telemetry

links.title: K: thousand · Mil: million · Bil: billion

panels.title: 1 · Overview
panels.description: Collection health and recorded usage for sessions active in the selected range. Tokens are recorded session totals at range end. K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (count(((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 1)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000))) or vector(0)) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

(count(((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 2)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000))) or vector(0)) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

(count((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session",kind="subagent"})) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000))) or vector(0)) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

sum((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_tokens{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session",token_kind="total"})) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 1) or (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 4)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000)))

panels.title: 2 · Token usage
panels.description: Recorded input and output token totals over time for selected sessions. These are snapshots of recorded history, not tokens spent in each time bucket; totals can decrease when the exported population changes. K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (sum((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_tokens{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session",token_kind="input"})) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 1) or (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 4)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000)))) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

(sum((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_tokens{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session",token_kind="output"})) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 1) or (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 4)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000)))) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

panels.title: 3 · Responses by chat
panels.description: Top eight selected sessions by recorded model responses at range end. These counts cover recorded session history and are distinct from user messages. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (topk(8, (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_response_count{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"})) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 1) or (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 4)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000)))) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

panels.title: 4 · Commands
panels.description: Commands recorded in the selected interval. Partial counts are lower bounds, marked ≥. Failed means a recorded failed outcome. Missing data displays —. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: ((count(((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000))) or vector(0)) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)) < 20) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)) and on () ((max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready) == 1) and on () (max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_complete_after_timestamp_seconds) < $__from / 1000))

((count(((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000))) or vector(0)) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)) < 20) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)) unless on () ((max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready) == 1) and on () (max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_complete_after_timestamp_seconds) < $__from / 1000))

((count((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session",outcome="failed"}) and on (project_id, session_id, observation_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000)))) or vector(0)) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)) < 20) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)) and on () ((max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready) == 1) and on () (max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_complete_after_timestamp_seconds) < $__from / 1000))

((count((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session",outcome="failed"}) and on (project_id, session_id, observation_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id) (cwo_codex_command_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000)))) or vector(0)) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)) < 20) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)) unless on () ((max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready) == 1) and on () (max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_complete_after_timestamp_seconds) < $__from / 1000))

(((max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready) == 1) and on () (max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_complete_after_timestamp_seconds) < $__from / 1000)) or (0 * max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_ready))) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_command_telemetry_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)) < 20) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

panels.title: 5 · Session activity
panels.description: Observed working and waiting sessions over the selected time range. Working means a recent open turn. Waiting means the last turn finished and no new turn has started. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (sum(((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 1)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000))) or vector(0)) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

(count(((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_state{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) == 2)) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000))) or vector(0)) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)

panels.title: 6 · Chats
panels.description: Sessions active in the selected range, sorted by recorded tokens. Model includes the latest selected effort. Tokens cover recorded session history, not account allowance. K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion. Click a chat to open Work Overview. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: (max by (project_id, session_id, work, kind, parent_id, model_effort) (label_join(label_replace(cwo_codex_session_info{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}, "work", "$1", "session_id", "(.+)"), "model_effort", " · ", "model", "effort"))) and on (project_id, session_id) ((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds{project_id=~"$project",session_id=~"$session"}) <= $__to / 1000)) and on () (max(cwo_codex_collector_source_available) == 1) and on () ((time() - max(cwo_codex_collector_scan_timestamp_seconds)) < 20)
